London update 01:35 CT: the reopen confirmed a cycle high (7749.25) without delivering the pullback; it's the bus's instrument closest to reacting. London plan: the same cluster, now reinforced by the double-weight 4h gap. ADR budget ~95pts (with London's calibration), 37% covered.

NY update · 07:56 CT: London's reopen confirmed a cycle high (7771.25) without a pullback; the day already spent 76% of its ATR, leaving only ~18pts of real budget. The EMA50/POC cluster at 7760-7765.75 is the only reference inside that margin; the richer 7735.25-7744.00 cluster is out of reach today (watch).

GC.es:
unico instrumento sin conflicto de marcos al cierre de Asia -- eso cambio esta noche. Update Londres 01:35 CT: la reapertura reclamo el TDO/VWAP, subio a 1.2pts del PDH (4422.10) y revirtio con fuerza a un minimo nuevo (4386.30), rompiendo la estructura de corto plazo a la baja. La tesis alcista de 3 dias entra en conflicto (invalidacion 4374.40 todavia no tocada). Plan de Londres: el retest del cluster roto 4396.6-4405.5 desde abajo es la unica referencia, sin GO por el conflicto de marcos. Presupuesto ADR ~139pts (con calibracion de Londres), 26% recorrido.

Update NY · 07:56 CT: tras el giro bajista de la madrugada, el precio subio de vuelta al cluster reclamado 4396.6-4405.5 y lo esta testeando ahora mismo (4401.0) sin resolver -- 5o test de la semana. El conflicto de marcos (diario -1 vs semanal +1) sigue bloqueando cualquier GO. Plan de NY: vigilar el reclamo sobre 4405.5 o el rechazo de vuelta bajo 4396.6.
GC.en:
the only instrument with no frame conflict at the Asia close -- that changed tonight. London update 01:35 CT: the reopen reclaimed TDO/VWAP, rallied to within 1.2pts of the PDH (4422.10) and reversed hard to a fresh low (4386.30), breaking the short-term structure lower. The 3-day bullish thesis is now in conflict (the 4374.40 invalidation hasn't been touched yet). London plan: a retest of the broken 4396.6-4405.5 cluster from below is the only reference, no GO given the frame conflict. ADR budget ~139pts (with London's calibration), 26% covered.

NY update · 07:56 CT: after this morning's bearish turn, price climbed back into the reclaimed 4396.6-4405.5 cluster and is testing it right now (4401.0) without resolving -- the week's 5th test. The frame conflict (daily -1 vs weekly +1) keeps blocking any GO. NY plan: watch for a reclaim above 4405.5 or a rejection back below 4396.6.

YM.es:
el instrumento mas dificil del bus, marcos opuestos tras el whipsaw mas violento de la semana. Update Londres 01:35 CT: subio con el complejo a un maximo de sesion (52291) pero sigue 89pts bajo su propio maximo del viernes (52380), sin reclamar 52344. Plan de Londres: cluster VWAP/POC 52200-52215 como unica referencia B; los niveles que deciden siguen siendo 51888 y 52344. Presupuesto ADR ~627pts, 34% recorrido.

Update NY · 07:56 CT: rompio con fuerza sobre 52344 y el maximo del viernes durante Londres, maximo de ciclo nuevo en 52557 -- la tesis bajista de 3 dias queda ROTA, sesgo pasa a alcista (1 dia de vida, tratar con cautela). Plan de NY: el cluster EMA20/ORL 52497-52513 es la referencia de retroceso; el sensor diario propio de YM todavia no confirma (va con retraso frente al precio).
YM.en:
the bus's hardest instrument, opposing frames after the week's most violent whipsaw. London update 01:35 CT: it rose with the complex to a session high (52291) but remains 89pts below its own Friday high (52380), without reclaiming 52344. London plan: the VWAP/POC 52200-52215 cluster as the only B reference; the levels that decide the day remain 51888 and 52344. ADR budget ~627pts, 34% covered.

NY update · 07:56 CT: it broke hard above 52344 and Friday's high during London, a fresh cycle high at 52557 -- the 3-day bearish thesis is now BROKEN, bias flips bullish (1 day old, treat with caution). NY plan: the EMA20/ORL cluster at 52497-52513 is the pullback reference; YM's own daily sensor still hasn't confirmed (it's lagging behind price).

CL.es:
sesion de bisagra pendiente de resolver al cierre de Asia -- ya resolvio. Update Londres 01:35 CT: la reapertura hizo un viaje redondo completo (subio a 97.22, colapso a un minimo nuevo de 93.58, bajo el del viernes) confirmando el reinicio bajista. El dia ya gasto el 88% de su ATR, casi sin presupuesto para Londres/NY. Plan de Londres: cualquier zona mas alla de unos pocos ticks es referencia, no plan operable; vigilar el cluster EMA20/EMA50/TDO 93.84-94.34. Sin EIA en la ventana de Londres (miercoles 09:30 CT).

Update NY · 07:56 CT: el reinicio bajista confirmado anoche siguio extendiendo, minimo nuevo en 92.87. El dia ya gasto 109% de su presupuesto de ATR -- sin margen real para NY, cualquier zona es solo referencia (cluster VWAP/EMA200 93.87-94.36 desde abajo).
CL.en:
a hinge session pending resolution at the Asia close -- it already resolved. London update 01:35 CT: the reopen made a full round trip (rallied to 97.22, collapsed to a fresh 93.58 low, below Friday's) confirming the bearish restart. The day has already spent 88% of its ATR, with almost no budget left for London/NY. London plan: any zone beyond a few ticks is a reference, not an operable plan; watch the EMA20/EMA50/TDO cluster at 93.84-94.34. No EIA inside the London window (Wednesday 09:30 CT).

NY update · 07:56 CT: last night's confirmed bearish restart kept extending, a fresh low at 92.87. The day already spent 109% of its ATR budget -- no real room left for NY, any zone is reference only (the VWAP/EMA200 cluster at 93.87-94.36 from below).
